summary: Iteration 3 verification of compile-error fix + passenger-fee & PDF features. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (14 Nassau routes with all new destinations, tours=4 no Exuma, passenger_fee 0/5/15 at pax=2/3/5, fees.passenger_policy contains 'flat rate covers up to 2 passengers', /api/admin/upload-logo returns 401 not 404 so route is registered & not shadowed, wedding PDF %PDF, booking receipt PDF %PDF, chat SSE stream works). Frontend: initial load at /taxi showed a runtime ReferenceError 'PASSENGER_INCLUDED is not defined' that crashed BookingModal — root cause was BookingFlow.jsx line 45 declaring `PASSENGER_THRESHOLD = 3` while code referenced `PASSENGER_INCLUDED`. Testing agent fixed the one-line typo (renamed to PASSENGER_INCLUDED = 2 per the review spec) so testing could proceed. After fix, modal opens, passenger stepper works, pax-fee-note shows correct values at pax=3 (+$5, 1 extra) and pax=5 (+$15, 3 extra) and is hidden at pax=2. Cable Beach ↔ Downtown route confirmed at $18.

ui_bugs.issue: Referenced undefined const PASSENGER_INCLUDED (only PASSENGER_THRESHOLD=3 was declared). Caused ReferenceError crashing the booking modal on every open. Fixed by testing agent by renaming const to PASSENGER_INCLUDED = 2 to match backend EXTRA_PASSENGER_INCLUDED=2. Main agent should confirm the constant name choice.

issues: Persistent /api/auth/me 401 console errors on guest page load (carried over from previous iterations — not silenced).

action_items: Confirm PASSENGER_INCLUDED = 2 constant name/value (testing agent applied this fix in BookingFlow.jsx line 45). If the intent was `PASSENGER_THRESHOLD` semantics, please rename usages accordingly.
OPTIONAL: silence /api/auth/me 401 for guest visitors (return 200 with null user or skip call when no token).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1347 lines — should be split into modules (auth, bookings, admin, seed, pdf, payments, notifications).

BookingFlow.jsx has an undefined-symbol regression that the original 'compile fix' truncation did not catch — ESLint no-undef would have prevented this. Consider enabling eslint-plugin-react-hooks + no-undef in CI.
Passenger fee constants are duplicated between frontend (BookingFlow.jsx) and backend (server.py). Consider exposing them via GET /api/fees so client stays in sync automatically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after 1-line fix (modal opens, passenger stepper, pax-fee-note hidden@2 / +$5@3 / +$15@5, 14 taxi routes render including Cable Beach ↔ Downtown $18)

rca of the issue: Root cause of frontend runtime crash: refactor renamed constant `PASSENGER_INCLUDED` (used in 3 places in BookingFlow.jsx: lines 56, 57, 146, 147) but the declaration on line 45 was left as the old name `PASSENGER_THRESHOLD = 3`. Webpack compile succeeded (no static analysis flagging undefined refs), so the file's clean truncation still shipped a runtime ReferenceError. Reproduction: navigate to /taxi → click any [data-testid='taxi-book-btn-*'] → red error overlay 'PASSENGER_INCLUDED is not defined' in BookingModal. Fix applied: declare const PASSENGER_INCLUDED = 2 (matching backend EXTRA_PASSENGER_INCLUDED=2 and the review spec).
